commit_message: Fix ADR 0133 HTTP status code typing
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0133 Remote AI Studio companion
pr_body:
## Summary

- add the loopback-only Remote AI Studio HTTP/SSE companion gateway over the existing authoritative Agent Host
- add client request idempotency, exact proposal-version Go, stale Stop/permission protection, snapshot + ordered event cursor recovery, safe captured-frame retrieval, and sanitized structured remote responses
- add a responsive web companion for conversation, proposal acceptance criteria, Go/Stop, pending decisions, run/completion progress, and captured-frame review
- preserve the existing loopback Editor MCP boundary and do not expose arbitrary shell, process, filesystem, Git, raw MCP, or native GPU/resource controls
- add integration-focused ADR 0133 regression coverage against the existing AgentHost contracts
- fix HTTP parser status-code literals to preserve the declared u16 error contract

## Validation

Run permanent Windows Validation with the repository planner. Remote companion UI changes require visual validation including narrow/mobile layout review.
